# Claude Code History Guard

> Independent Windows PowerShell toolkit for local Claude Code Desktop history
> backups and missing-only session metadata copies between explicit account scopes.

Experimental, local-only and offline for publication. Not an Anthropic product,
cloud chat migration tool, credential manager or zero-data-loss guarantee.

## Start here

- [Overview and quick start](README.md): requirements, commands and account-switch workflow.
- [Guía en español](README.es.md): introducción, privacidad y uso.
- [Safety model](docs/safety.md): protected files, snapshot coverage and failure boundaries.
- [Usage and recovery](docs/usage.md): optional helper, event states and separate-folder restore.
- [Testing](docs/testing.md): generated fixtures, process mocks and reproducible validation.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): change and privacy requirements.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting without real history.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): repository-specific implementation constraints.

## Important facts

- Preview is read-only; Apply requires a fully closed Desktop app.
- Existing conversations are never replaced by the sync engine.
- Task definitions, group settings, credentials and Claude configuration are not write targets.
- Automatic operation shares new names; preexisting names are excluded by default.
- Source metadata and transcript versions must match a verified automatic snapshot.
- Local configuration, logs and backups do not belong in this repository.
- Account switching in a running app is not intercepted. A full restart may be needed.
- Fixture tests do not establish compatibility with every Desktop release.
